summary: Frontend-only regression + new-feature testing for LinQ Rides. All 12 targeted flows PASS on mobile viewport (375x667). Rides tab top tabs (requests/posts/upcoming), sub-tabs, and daily/planned kind chips all switch content. Accept-request bottom sheet opens with 'Confirm Request', shows Verified badge + route + seats stepper (12.50 -> 37.50 -> 25.00 confirmed for Sarah J. price 12.5), Confirm & Lock In transitions sheet to 'Ride Confirmed' with confirmed box, 'Message Sarah J.' button navigates to /chat/c1 (chat-screen), Done closes; toast 'Ride locked in with Sarah J.' appears; card shows 'Accepted ✓'. Decline (in2) -> 'Declined' + toast; Sent delete-sn1 -> 'Withdrawn' + toast. Published posts show analytics strip (views/requests/seats — 142/6/3); edit-pp1 -> /create-ride, search-pp1 -> /search-results. Drafts show DRAFT tag + Publish action. Upcoming cards show Confirmed badge; chat-upcoming-up1 -> /chat/c1; view-details-up1 -> /ride/r_1. Home find-ride-twin-button correctly navigates to /search-results (regression fix confirmed) with filter chips + open-filters sheet. LinQ logo image (500x500 png) renders correctly on onboarding + login (splash uses same component). No page errors, no red-screen. One benign console warning from a lib about React 19 element.ref (non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: rides.tsx is ~500 lines and mixes 3 list variants + bottom sheet — consider splitting RequestList / PostList / UpcomingList / AcceptSheet into separate files under src/components/rides/ for maintainability (not a bug, code hygiene).
React 19 element.ref deprecation warning surfaces in console (from @gorhom/bottom-sheet or expo-router). Non-blocking now but will break in a future React release — track library upgrade.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new Rides-tab features (accept detail sheet w/ stepper + fare calc, chat link post-lock-in, published-post analytics strip), the LinQ logo swap, and the Home find-ride-twin -> search-results regression are all verified working on mobile web preview. Test flow: skip-onboarding -> skip-login -> Home -> find-ride-twin (verify /search-results) -> back to Home -> Rides tab -> exercise all sub-tabs/chips and accept-in1 sheet -> lock in -> go-chat -> back -> decline-in2 -> sent delete-sn1 -> posts published analytics + edit-pp1 + search-pp1 -> drafts -> upcoming chat + view-details. All testIDs listed in the review request exist and behave as specified.
